title: Development Order Addendum — Wave insertions for AF-38/AF-39 (FR-25/FR-26)
sequence_rules_inherited: Topological: dep AF in earlier or same wave (verified by self-check against the AF graph)
SERIES execution: wave N fully green before wave N+1 starts
Per-wave gate: wave's pytest subset GREEN + store gates green locally; no remote tier configured
Error surfacing (AF-30) and schema decoupling (AF-29) are foundational: no code ships that swallows errors or keys off header text/position

test_gate_map.TC-60: Duplicate company name (case/whitespace variant) is HARD BLOCKED with named error — normalized (trim/case-insensitive) name-key block against an active position
test_gate_map.TC-61: Duplicate ISIN with a different company name is HARD BLOCKED — ISIN-key match blocks even though names differ
test_gate_map.TC-62: Both keys match (normalized name AND ISIN): still a single HARD BLOCK with named error, no double error and no bypass (unit over the lock decision)
test_gate_map.TC-65: Block message content matches the SRS AC shape exactly ('Cannot add position: <company> has an active position (<status>)'), Danger blocker named as Danger, message surfaced not swallowed

wave_insertions.rationale: AF-39 is a pure validator over bonds + live D5 statuses; it lands with the status engine (AF-14) it consumes, same wave as AF-10..AF-16. The four lock-validator scenarios (name-key, ISIN-key, both-keys, message shape — Test_Plan_addendum_v1 TC titles) gate W2 with AF-39; the form-driven lifecycle cases stay in W4.

test_gate_map.TC-59: Add form happy path: one submit creates one bonds row rendered by grid, watch list and dashboard (FR-25 single master row, total bond count +1)
test_gate_map.TC-63: Completed position releases the lock: the next add succeeds and the new position computes On-going (release only on Completed per D5)
test_gate_map.TC-64: Re-buy after Completed starts On-going and re-locks: a further add is HARD BLOCKED with the named error (re-lock flow)
test_gate_map.TC-66: No override: an add attempt with a force/override flag or param is still rejected with the same HARD BLOCK; the add path contains no force-accept branch

wave_insertions.rationale: AF-38 is the user-visible form-handler slice and needs the lock validator (AF-39, W2) plus the route/error foundations; it joins AF-23..AF-25 in W4 where the watch list/grid surfaces exist to redirect and re-render the single master row. The form-driven lifecycle cases (happy path, Completed-release, re-buy re-lock, no-override — Test_Plan_addendum_v1 TC titles) gate W4 with AF-38.

topology_note: TOPOT check against v1 wave assignments, stated explicitly: AF-39's deps are AF-01 (W0) and AF-14 (W2) — both satisfied in W2 (W0 < W2; AF-14 is same-wave W2, allowed by the earlier-or-same rule). AF-38's deps are AF-01 (W0), AF-30 (W0) and AF-39 (W2, via this addendum) — all satisfied in W4 (W0 < W4, W2 < W4). Wave order holds: AF-39's wave index (W2) is strictly less than AF-38's wave index (W4), so the lock validator is implemented and green before the add form that calls it. No cross-wave back-edge is introduced; every other v1 AF->wave assignment and test gate is unchanged.
change_record: addendum v1.0 extends Development_Order_DK_Bond_Tracker_v1 after owner decisions D14/D15 (2026-10-30); inserts AF-39 into W2 and AF-38 into W4 with no change to any existing wave's AF list or TC gates. TC-59..TC-66 come from docs/Test_Plan_addendum_v1.json, which appeared during self-check (parallel worker); titles in test_gate_map are aligned to that document and the scenario split is: lock-validator TCs (TC-60 name-key, TC-61 ISIN-key, TC-62 both-keys, TC-65 message shape) gate W2 with AF-39; add-form and release/re-lock flow TCs (TC-59 happy path, TC-63 Completed-release, TC-64 re-buy re-lock, TC-66 no-override) gate W4 with AF-38.
